vision.title: Our vision
vision.body: That Mukhtabir becomes a daily tool for every psychiatrist in Syria today 🤓 — a single trusted bank that spares the physician hours of gathering questions from scattered, unattributed files, and accompanies them in studying and preparing for specialty exams. Because the question and the answer are an effective way of studying, not only of being tested, we believe verified psychiatric knowledge should be within everyone's reach at low or no cost. We aspire for Mukhtabir to be a model of scientific verification quality, one that physicians in other specialties draw on. Formal accreditation is an aspiration we pursue when the conditions allow, not a condition for our continuity.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: To build a verified question bank in which every question carries the name of its verifier and its reference source, governed by a single verification standard applied by all, and in which every reported question is reviewed. We grow gradually: more questions, higher verification quality, and broader reference unification. Our core is the bank and the verification; every other tool — tests, analytics, the knowledge map — serves that core rather than standing as an end in itself.

questionManagement.title: Full question management
questionManagement.description: Add, edit, delete, advanced search, multi-filter, duplicate, and export in multiple formats.

twoModes.title: Two test modes
twoModes.description: A timed exam, and self-study with per-answer explanations and multiple filters.

markdownSupport.title: Full Markdown support
markdownSupport.description: Write questions and explanations in rich formatting with a live preview.

membership.title: Advanced membership system
membership.description: Multiple roles (admin / doctor) with a configurable validity period and auto-renewal.

verification.title: Integrated verification system
verification.description: Review questions with detailed statistics and a trust score per user.

tagging.title: Smart organisation
tagging.description: Manage tags and categories with smart suggestions and colour-coded categories.

backup.title: Advanced backup
backup.description: Protect your data with import and export in multiple formats.

arabicUI.title: Professional Arabic interface
arabicUI.description: Full Arabic support with RTL and four visual themes.

ai.title: Technical and AI support
ai.intro: This system was developed with the aid of the latest AI technologies and advanced coding assistants, which helped accelerate development and ensure code quality:

testers.title: Testing and verification team
testers.intro: We extend our sincere thanks and appreciation to the physicians who contributed to testing the system and verifying its scientific content, ensuring high quality and reliability of the educational material presented. Names are listed in alphabetical order:

tech.title: Technical stack
tech.intro: Every technology in this system was chosen after weighing performance, security, ease of maintenance, and the ability to run in a self-contained local environment without external cloud services.

frontend.title: Frontend
frontend.intro: The interactive presentation layer — built on Vue components with centralised state, client-side routing, and an instant build tool.

backend.title: Backend
backend.intro: The service layer — Django and Django REST Framework provide a complete REST API, with a ready-made admin panel and tabular data processing.

database.title: Database and storage
database.intro: The data layer — a local SQLite database with advanced performance tuning, and flexible JSON storage for dynamic data.

security.title: Security and privacy
security.intro: The protection layer — strong password hashing, request-forgery protection, rate limiting, and secure cookies.

items.vue: The core frontend framework — Composition API with single-file components.
items.pinia: Centralised state management with full support for themes and cross-store synchronisation.
items.router: Client-side routing, route guards, and lazy loading of components.
items.vite: A very fast build tool with instant hot-module replacement during development and smart chunking.
items.chartjs: Charting library for analytics, leaderboards, and verification distribution.
items.markdown: Rich authoring of questions and explanations in Markdown, with live preview.
items.icons: Lightweight SVG icons, visually consistent across every screen.
items.django: A full web framework with a built-in ORM and a ready-made admin panel.
items.drf: Builds the REST API, with serialisation, rate limiting, and authentication.
items.filter: Advanced filtering of datasets directly from queries.
items.jazzmin: A modern customisation layer for the data-admin panel, themed to match the app.
items.dotenv: Safe management of environment variables outside the source code.
items.pandas: Bulk import and export of Excel, CSV, and JSON tables.
items.sqlite: A lightweight file-based database — no separate server, no complex maintenance.
items.wal: Write-Ahead Logging mode for better concurrent reads while writing.
items.orm: The database abstraction layer, with automatic protection against SQL injection.
items.json: Flexible JSON fields for answers and other dynamic data.
items.files: Local storage for images, backups, and exported files.
items.pbkdf2: Password hashing with the PBKDF2-SHA256 algorithm and a unique salt per user.
items.csrf: Full protection against request-forgery attacks via session-bound tokens.
items.session: Session-based authentication, with secure server-side storage.
items.throttle: Per-endpoint rate limiting to prevent abuse.
items.cookies: HttpOnly and SameSite cookies, protecting against XSS.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.intro: We believe medical education should be available to everyone. We designed the system according to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1) to ensure a smooth experience for all users:

keyboard.title: Keyboard support
keyboard.description: All functions are available via keyboard shortcuts for fast navigation.

screenReaders.title: Screen readers
screenReaders.description: All interactive elements carry appropriate ARIA labels.

contrast.title: Adequate colour contrast
contrast.description: All themes meet WCAG AA colour-contrast standards.

touchTargets.title: Large touch targets
touchTargets.description: All buttons are at least 44×44 pixels for ease of use.
